verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documentation of a data retention policy, GDPR-style deletion API, or user-controlled purge mechanism—only a generic account export endpoint (mailchimp-docs-16). Community reports actually describe the opposite of user control: accounts and mailing lists being deleted or banned without warning or recourse (mailchimp-comm-1, mailchimp-comm-2), and no way to pause without deleting all data (mailchimp-comm-7), but since Mailchimp never explicitly claims a retention/deletion control feature, this is 'none' rather than 'disputed'.
